params.body:
Closes #1151

## Why

A chassis lookup asks VWE and then AutoConnect, inside the web request. Production stops a request after 30 seconds, and AutoConnect took more than 20 seconds for 48 of the 355 answers kept in the 60 days before 24 November. AutoConnect is the only source of category, body style, fuel, weight and dimensions.

Every fix so far treated a consequence:

- #1114 put the three calls in a 24-second budget, so the modal always answers. AutoConnect got 10 seconds of it, later 20 (#1129). That cut off its slow answers, and those sheets came back with VWE's fields only.
- #1125 fetched a late answer in the background and kept it, but did not fill the sheet. The garage had to look up again, for a second token.

The cause is a slow external call inside a web request.

## What changes

- **`RunChassisLookup`** is a new job that does what the request did: VWE, AutoConnect, the dealer's defaults, the chassis number and the default dimensions.
  - It spends the token only when something came back (R S1-2.6), counted down in the database.
  - It signs the user in on the guard for the services, as `IntegrationChecks` does.
  - It has one try and a timeout of 180 seconds, under the worker's 328.
  - A job the queue starts after 90 seconds calls nobody.
- **`ChassisLookups`** keeps the state in the cache, as the smoke round does.
  - Each lookup has one entry. A second click while a lookup runs follows the running one, so a double click is never a second invoice.
- **`createFromVIN`** starts the job.
  - On a real queue it answers 202 with an address to ask.
  - On a sync queue (every environment but production) the job runs in the request, and the answer is the result, as before.
- **`chassisLookupStatus`** is the new GET the modal asks every two seconds.
  - It answers 202 with the step while the lookup runs.
  - Once the lookup is done it gives the same answers the lookup always gave: 200 with the flash, or 400 in the one shape with one sentence.
  - It is readable for the vehicle's own garage only.
- **`slVinLookup`** is one function in the modal for the four pages that post it. It posts, asks until the lookup is done, names the step in the busy line and stops after five minutes. The pages keep their own success and failure handlers.
- **Provider limits.** `lookupSeconds` and the budget go. Each provider gets its own limit:
  - VWE: 30 seconds;
  - AutoConnect: 90 seconds;
  - CarWizard: 20 seconds;
  - each connection: 5 seconds.
- **Removed:** `KeepAutoConnectAnswer`, `keepAutoConnectAnswer` and the two messages that asked the garage to look up again.
- **Rules and findings.**
  - R S1-2.23 and R S1-2.24 are rewritten.
  - New finding: `de-chassisopvraging-hoorde-niet-in-een-webverzoek`.

## Tests

- `AChassisLookupWaitsForAutoConnectTest` (14 tests) replaces `ALateAutoConnectAnswerIsKeptForTheNextLookupTest` and keeps its two tests on reusing a kept answer. It covers:
  - 202 with the address, and no token yet;
  - one job for two clicks;
  - the steps, then done, partial and nothing back;
  - a job started too late, a job that breaks, and a dead lookup that does not block the next one;
  - another garage gets a 404;
  - a sync queue answers with the result;
  - the provider limits against the job's timeout;
  - the four pages use `slVinLookup`.
- The polling function was also run in Node against a fake server: waiting then done, waiting then refused, a lost poll, a network failure on the post, a 504 that is no JSON, a lookup that never ends (it stops after five minutes), and a validation error.
- The full suite is green (3361 tests, the same 9 notices as on main), and so are PHPStan and the rules tests.

## Production, read on 26 November

- The cache store is `file` and the queue is `database`, on the same box for the web and the worker. Nothing was waiting on the queue, and no job failed in the last 14 days.
- Of the 8 AutoConnect lookups since #1129, 1 was answered within the request.
  - For 4, the request kept nothing and an answer arrived 30 to 85 seconds later. That is the background job of #1125 fetching what the request cut off at 20 seconds, and those sheets needed a second lookup to get it.
  - For 3, no usable answer came, also not with the job's 45 seconds. That is why AutoConnect gets 90 seconds here.
- One chassis number was looked up three times in five minutes on two sheets, and AutoConnect sent nothing back any of those times.
params.title: Run the chassis lookup as a job
